title: Drunk Woman Causes Car Accident Then Loads on the Criminal Charges
description:
Be responsible, don't drink and drive, and own up to your actions.

On December 29, 2021, police were dispatched to a two-vehicle accident in La Crosse, WI. When they arrived, they discovered the operator of the striking vehicle was a 27-year-old woman. She was put through standardized field sobriety tests and was arrested for operating while under the influence based on the officer’s observations. Instead of just an OWI charge, she adds more into the cart…
